cause: The port remained empty and unfocused in guest-reset-003. The later hit and animation checks used requestAnimationFrame inside Runtime.evaluate(awaitPromise), so a paused panel could strand the evaluation until the CDP transport timeout, without its last pointer sample.
repair: The test scrolls the unique visible target, samples hit target, ancestor animation and center position through synchronous CDP evaluations, and requires three stable samples before a real CDP mouse press/release. Node enforces a three-second stability deadline; the existing CDP transport has a five-second per-command timeout. Failures retain the latest sampled geometry and hit state.
inputMechanics: SettingsView renders a controlled numeric Input with onChange. The test still requires a real pointer click to focus that Input, then CDP Input.insertText, and checks both the DOM value and focus before clicking Set. It does not assign DOM value/focus or seed port storage.

guestReset005.observed: The native run persisted Dark theme, engine port 65001, and the disposable session fixture, then reported reset_dialog_not_observed after clicking Clear local data on this device.
guestReset005.sourceEvidence: Frozen SettingsView source 1cd0a3f and current SettingsView are identical on this path: the ActionRow click sets clearLocalDataOpen true and renders @ai-matrx/design-system ConfirmDialog with title Clear local data?, Cancel, and Clear & sign out. The bundled design system renders Radix AlertDialogContent with role=alertdialog and data-slot=alert-dialog-title; the prior test queried only role=dialog.
guestReset005.repair: The test now detects the specifically titled reset alertdialog and targets its Cancel and Clear & sign out buttons within that alertdialog through the same real CDP pointer path. Both cancel preservation and confirm clearing assertions remain required.
